set -e
export PGPASSWORD=$POSTGRES_PASSWORD;
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --username "$POSTGRES_USER" --dbname "$POSTGRES_DB" <<-EOSQL
  CREATE USER $FINERACT_DB_USER WITH PASSWORD '$FINERACT_DB_PASS';
  CREATE DATABASE $FINERACT_TENANTS_DB_NAME;
  CREATE DATABASE $FINERACT_TENANT_DEFAULT_DB_NAME;
  GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE $FINERACT_TENANTS_DB_NAME TO $FINERACT_DB_USER;
  GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE $FINERACT_TENANT_DEFAULT_DB_NAME TO $FINERACT_DB_USER;
  \c $FINERACT_TENANTS_DB_NAME
  GRANT ALL ON SCHEMA public TO $FINERACT_DB_USER;
  \c $FINERACT_TENANT_DEFAULT_DB_NAME
  GRANT ALL ON SCHEMA public TO $FINERACT_DB_USER;
EOSQL

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
  [string]$EnvironmentPath = (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\..\.env')
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $EnvironmentPath)) {
  throw "Local environment file is missing: $EnvironmentPath. Run restore-runtime-env.ps1 first."
}

$content = Get-Content -LiteralPath $EnvironmentPath
if ($content | Where-Object { $_ -match '^CLEARING_CALLBACK_SECRET=.+$' }) {
  Write-Output 'CLEARING_CALLBACK_SECRET is already present.'
  exit 0
}

$bytes = [byte[]]::new(32)
[System.Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator]::Fill($bytes)
$secret = [Convert]::ToHexString($bytes).ToLowerInvariant()
[System.IO.File]::AppendAllText((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $EnvironmentPath), "`nCLEARING_CALLBACK_SECRET=$secret`n", (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
Write-Output 'Added a generated CLEARING_CALLBACK_SECRET to the local environment file.'

databaseChangeLog:
  - changeSet:
      id: v3-p2-2-idempotency-v4-response-fields
      author: P2-2
      preConditions:
        - onFail: HALT
        - tableExists:
            tableName: idempotency_record
      changes:
        - addColumn:
            tableName: idempotency_record
            columns:
              - column:
                  name: http_status
                  type: integer
              - column:
                  name: response_headers
                  type: jsonb
                  defaultValueComputed: "'{}'::jsonb"
        - sql:
            splitStatements: false
            sql: |
              UPDATE idempotency_record
              SET http_status = status_code,
                  response_headers = COALESCE(response_headers, '{}'::jsonb),
                  expires_at = COALESCE(expires_at, created_at + interval '24 hours'),
                  status = COALESCE(status, 'OK');
              ALTER TABLE idempotency_record
                ALTER COLUMN response_body TYPE jsonb USING response_body::jsonb,
                ALTER COLUMN status SET NOT NULL,
                ALTER COLUMN expires_at SET NOT NULL,
                ALTER COLUMN expires_at SET DEFAULT (now() + interval '24 hours'),
                ALTER COLUMN response_headers SET NOT NULL,
                ALTER COLUMN response_headers SET DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb;
  - changeSet:
      id: v3-p2-2-transfer-idempotency-scope-fk
      author: P2-2
      preConditions:
        - onFail: HALT
        - tableExists:
            tableName: transfer
      changes:
        - sql:
            splitStatements: false
            sql: |
              ALTER TABLE transfer DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_transfer_idempotency;
              ALTER TABLE transfer ADD CONSTRAINT fk_transfer_idempotency
         
       FOREIGN KEY (idempotency_key) REFERENCES idempotency_record(scope_key);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idempotency_record (
  idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY,
  request_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  response_body TEXT NOT NULL,
  status_code INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customer_identity (
  subject VARCHAR(128) PRIMARY KEY,
  fineract_client_id BIGINT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transfer (
  transfer_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES idempotency_record(idempotency_key),
  source_account_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  destination_account_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  amount NUMERIC(19,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  currency CHAR(3) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  score INTEGER,
  scoring_reason VARCHAR(240),
  core_reference VARCHAR(128),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
ALTER TABLE transfer ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS subject VARCHAR(128);
ALTER TABLE transfer ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS failure_reason VARCHAR(240);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notification (
  notification_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  subject VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  notification_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  read_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transfer_receipt (
  receipt_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  transfer_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES transfer(transfer_id),
  subject VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS beneficiary (
  beneficiary_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  subject VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  account_token CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  a

ccount_last4 VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL,
  display_name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE(subject, account_token)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transfer_outbox (
  event_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  transfer_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES transfer(transfer_id),
  event_type VARCHAR(96) NOT NULL,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  published_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  next_attempt_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inbox_event (
  consumer_name VARCHAR(96) NOT NULL,
  event_id UUID NOT NULL,
  processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (consumer_name, event_id)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS clearing_payment (
  clearing_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  transfer_id UUID NOT NULL,
  scenario VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  delivery_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_sequence INTEGER,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS risk_decision (
  decision_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  transfer_id UUID NOT NULL,
  decision VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
  reason VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL,
  maker_subject VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  checker_subject VARCHAR(128),
  approval_reason VARCHAR(240),
  version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
ALTER TABLE risk_decision ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS checker_subject VARCHAR(128);
ALTER TABLE risk_decision ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS approval_reason VARCHAR(240);
ALTER TABLE risk_decision ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS loan_application (
  application_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,

subject VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  fineract_client_id BIGINT,
  requested_amount NUMERIC(19,2) NOT NULL CHECK (requested_amount > 0),
  term_months INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (term_months BETWEEN 1 AND 480),
  purpose VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
ALTER TABLE loan_application ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS core_loan_id BIGINT;
ALTER TABLE loan_application ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS core_idempotency_key VARCHAR(128);
ALTER TABLE loan_application ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS score INTEGER;
ALTER TABLE loan_application ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS scoring_reason VARCHAR(240);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS loan_document (
  document_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  application_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES loan_application(application_id),
  subject VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  document_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  storage_ref VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RECEIVED',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS loan_approval (
  approval_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  application_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES loan_application(application_id),
  maker_subject VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  checker_subject VARCHAR(128),
  status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
  reason VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS eod_run (
  run_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  business_date DATE NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
  reconciliation_status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
  reason VARCHAR(240),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reconciliation_run (
  run_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  reconciliation_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
  difference

_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  details TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dead_letter_event (
  event_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  consumer_name VARCHAR(96) NOT NULL,
  reason VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transfer_reversal (
  reversal_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  transfer_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES transfer(transfer_id),
  maker_subject VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  checker_subject VARCHAR(128),
  status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
  reason VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  core_reference VARCHAR(128),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS security_audit_event (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  event_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  actor_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  actor_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  resource_type VARCHAR(64),
  resource_id VARCHAR(128),
  action VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  outcome VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  request_id VARCHAR(128),
  correlation_id VARCHAR(128),
  before_json JSONB,
  after_json JSONB,
  previous_hash CHAR(64),
  record_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transfer_state_history (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  transfer_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES transfer(transfer_id),
  from_status VARCHAR(32),
  to_status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  reason_code VARCHAR(64),
  actor_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  actor_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
ALTER TABLE transfer ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS correlation_id VARCHAR(128);
